svg.title: Deadlock Modworks dependency levels
svg.desc: UML component diagram of the #include graph in src, layered by stability. Stable modules are at the top, volatile modules at the bottom, and every dependency arrow points up.
svg.text: Every #include in src/, drawn as UML components. A module sits one level below the lowest module it uses, so every arrow points up and nothing depends on a module beneath it.

Arrows are the transitive reduction: an arrow already implied by a longer path is left out. I = Ce / (Ca + Ce). Ca and Ce count project modules only. Commits are changes to the file pair in git history.
